description: This file handles the creation and management of 'Notify' messages within a USP (Universal Service Platform) agent. It defines functions for generating various notification types such as value changes, object creation/deletion, events, onboard requests, and operation completions/ failures. It manages message IDs, incorporates external protobuf message definitions, and constructs message objects for transmission to a controller, supporting the agent's notification mechanism.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_ValueChange(char * path,char * value,char * subscription_id,bool send_resp)
methods.description: Creates a Value Change Notify message with specified data model path, new value, subscription ID, and response requirement.

methods.name: void MSG_HANDLER_HandleNotifyResp(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Processes a received NotifyResponse message, removing pending retries if acknowledged.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_ObjectCreation(char * obj_path,char * subscription_id,bool send_resp)
methods.description: Creates an Object Creation Notify message for a specified object path, subscription ID, and response requirement.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_ObjectDeletion(char * obj_path,char * subscription_id,bool send_resp)
methods.description: Creates an Object Deletion Notify message for a specified object path, subscription ID, and response requirement.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_OperCompleteSuccess(kv_vector_t * output_args,char * command,char * command_key,char * subscription_id,bool send_resp)
methods.description: Creates an Operation Complete (success) Notify message with optional output arguments.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_OperCompleteFailure(int err_code,char * err_msg,char * command,char * command_key,char * subscription_id,bool send_resp)
methods.description: Creates an Operation Complete (failure) Notify message with error code and message.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * MSG_HANDLER_CreateNotifyReq_Event(char * event_name,kv_vector_t * output_args,char * subscription_id,bool send_resp)
methods.description: Creates an Event Notify message with event name, optional output arguments, subscription ID, and response requirement.

methods.description: Creates an OnBoardRequest notification with device identifiers.

methods.description: Generates a unique notification message ID based on notify type and timestamp.

methods.description: Transfers unique key parameters into an Object Creation message, destroying the original key-value vector.
